_about: Source photos of the eval beyond the six OnQ photos: Wikimedia Commons files (licence read from the Commons API extmetadata, not from the page title, 2026-10-21) and frames of Mikhail Oskola's own under-sink video (consent 2026-10-21T11:38:30Z). Zones were placed BY HAND on a 10% grid by the eval lane on 2026-10-21 by looking at each picture; steps are generic per family so a look-alike of the same family plausibly satisfies them.
_split: Split by GROUP (one scene or one object photographed several times): calibration if sha256('stepspotter-eval-split:'+group)[0] < 128, else test. The OnQ scenes keep the split in fixtures/perception/scenes.json.

panel.title: Find the patch panel
panel.action: Open the network cabinet and find the patch panel where the room cables land.
panel.evidence_required: the open network cabinet or panel with the patch panel ports and their cables clearly visible

jack.title: Check the network wall jack
jack.action: Look at the wall plate and check the network jack is seated in it.
jack.evidence_required: the wall plate with the network (RJ45) jack seated in it, seen from the front

jack_open.title: Check the jack's wiring
jack_open.action: Open the jack and check the wire pairs are punched into its colour-coded slots.
jack_open.evidence_required: the open network jack with the wire pairs punched into its colour-coded slots

socket.title: Check the wall socket
socket.action: Check the telephone socket is fixed flat to the wall.
socket.evidence_required: the telephone wall socket, seen from the front, fixed to the wall

box.title: Open the junction box
box.action: Take the cover off the junction box and look at the wires inside.
box.evidence_required: the open junction box with the wires inside it visible

trap.title: Check the sink trap
trap.action: Wipe the trap under the sink dry and look at its joints for a new drop.
trap.evidence_required: the drain trap under the sink with its slip-nut joints in focus

tap.title: Run the tap
tap.action: Turn the tap on to test the drain.
tap.evidence_required: water running from the tap into the basin

valve.title: Check the supply valve
valve.action: Check the shut-off valve on the supply line under the sink.
valve.evidence_required: the shut-off valve on the supply line with its handle visible

sink.title: Show the sink
sink.action: Step back and photograph the whole sink with its faucet.
sink.evidence_required: the whole sink with its wall-mounted faucet

downspout.title: Check the downspout outlet
downspout.action: Look at the bottom of the downspout where the water comes out.
downspout.evidence_required: the downspout and its outlet at the bottom, clearly visible

elbow.title: Check the disposal's drain elbow
elbow.action: Wipe the disposal's black drain elbow dry and look for a new drop.
elbow.evidence_required: the black drain elbow on the disposal, in focus

tailpiece.title: Check the sink tailpiece
tailpiece.action: Look at the white tailpiece under the sink drain and its joints.
tailpiece.evidence_required: the white tailpiece under the sink drain with its joints visible
